messages:
Ravi (CSM): Heads-up — TidalTech renewal in ~6w. Noticed embeddings and search calls dropped ~70% last 2 weeks, procurement asked for a competitor comparison. Putting thread here for triage.
Abe (AM): can you paste the usage delta and any error/latency trends?
Ravi (CSM): telemetry snapshot:
```
14d tokens/day: 28k -> 9k -> 3.5k (last 3d)
Active seats: 32 -> 20
Top routes: /embed (65%), /search (20%), /chat (15%)
Errors: transient 504 on 2025-02-12 (3m), recovered
Latencies: p95 embeddings ~110ms (stable)
```
Sofia (Sales): who is procurement talking to? competitor name?
Priya (TidalTech): Procurement looped in a vendor called "VectorFast" and a new infra lead, Jonah, is running a side-by-side pilot. Our ask: provide a cost/latency matrix for embeddings, and confirm VPC/on-prem pilot ability. Finance put new commitments on hold pending pilot.
Liam (Eng): we can run a short 7-day dedicated pilot (2xA10) to reproduce throughput. We can also produce a per-1M-embed cost chart with and without caching + quantization. On-prem pilot needs legal & infra lead access; estimate +10 business days to provision.
Abe (AM): propose: 1) offer 7-day dedicated pilot (discounted) 2) deliver perf matrix + competitive note vs VectorFast 3) schedule 30-min tech readout with Eng and Jonah 4) provide a concise finance one-pager. Legal OK?
Ravi (CSM): I'll own scheduling and the finance one-pager. Priya — can you confirm Jonah's target p95 and cost threshold?
Priya (TidalTech): Jonah wants p95 <120ms at our current QPS and cost < $25 per 1M embeddings after cache. He also asked if Redwood supports BYOK for VPC deployments.
Liam (Eng): BYOK is available for Private; pilot can use test keys. Full BYOK/HSM adds provisioning time. We'll include a reproducible script and expected numbers.
Sofia (Sales): I'll prep a short pilot commercial note (30% pilot discount and rollback terms). Abe — can you draft quick commercial terms and loop Legal?
Abe (AM): on it. Looping Legal now. ops-bot: created renewal_watch:tidaltech:1819991111 assigned:@Ravi; follow-up reminder set for 72h.
Ravi (CSM): thanks all — I'll post the tech-readout invite and Jonah's perf targets once confirmed. :thumbsup:
